claude_proposed_widenings.name: GrantResistanceOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants Resistance to Poison damage for its duration. OngoingOperation only covers roll_modifier and damage_on_hit — there is no operation variant that emits the v4 grant_resistance atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it has Resistance to Poison damage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ModifyRollAdvantageOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants Advantage on saving throws related to the Poisoned condition. OngoingOperation's RollModifierOperation only adds a numeric DiceDelta — it cannot express advantage/disadvantage. A new operation variant is needed to carry the modify_roll_advantage atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffectMechanics.operations (plural)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingEffectMechanics.operation is a single OngoingOperation. This spell needs two concurrent ongoing effects (resistance + advantage on saves). Changing to operations: ReadonlyArray<OngoingOperation> is the minimal surface fix.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition, and it has Resistance to Poison damage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpellMechanics cast-time instant effect slot
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell immediately removes the Poisoned condition at cast time, independent of the ongoing effect. No existing family supports 'instantaneous effect at cast + ongoing effect for duration'. A castEffect field (or similar) on OngoingEffectMechanics would cover this; alternatively a new family for instant+ongoing spells.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch a creature and end the Poisoned condition on it.
